premises.text: Charisma prepopulates user profiles and friends lists from existing social media accounts
premises.evidence_span: we prepopulate your profile with your existing data from Facebook and Twitter, so you don't have to fill your profile initially

premises.text: Users can see and interact with people nearby immediately after signing up
premises.evidence_span: immediately after you sign up, you would be able to see the people nearby, not only your existing contacts and your social graph

premises.text: Sparks allow users to encourage others to interact without making the first call
premises.evidence_span: you can actually send them a spark to encourage them to call you back

premises.text: Charisma enables spontaneous interactions that traditional dating sites do not
premises.evidence_span: you wouldn't be able to do this kind of spontaneous interactions using the usual old-school dating sites

premises.text: Charisma is a mobile, location-based, and real-time app
premises.evidence_span: Charisma is mobile. They launch on Apple devices, and Android will follow. It's location-based. You can interact with your existing contacts as well as with people who are outside of your existing graph, with people nearby. And Charisma is real-time.

premises.text: The app is ad-based with a subscription option to remove ads
premises.evidence_span: we are initially ads based with subscription to turn all the ads

value.text: Users can interact with nearby people in a spontaneous and fun way
value.evidence_span: you can filter them by age and so on. And you can actually call them right now.

notes: No separate premises for features that would require the same change.
